Highland Holds

Your neighbors keep winter in their storehouses and thunder in their songs. Frost preserves the harvest; a sharp report carries a warning across the crags.

What did your neighbors trust you to carry?

Rules

Type: Culture. Status: Proposal. Choose one paired option; do not mix the rank from one with the card from another.

- Frost 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.8b295167b8732413.JournalEntryPage.1478af2a406eb919]{Winter Store}. - Storm 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.e58831a6b6ad0d96.JournalEntryPage.c22beedf9cebd649]{Thunder at the Door}.

Grant at level 0. Duplicate grants provide 1 stage DP each; never promote a rank automatically. No discipline purchases at level 0. Ancestry does not restrict this choice. Follow each card’s explicit equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +7 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
